subject: Backend interns at Abstra?
body: I'm a third-year CS student in Bengaluru who builds backend services. Recently I tracked down and patched a decimal rounding bug in spreadsheet series auto-fill, and wrote a Bitcoin transaction parser from scratch without external libraries. Is the team open to taking an intern? If not, a pointer to whoever handles hiring would be great. My resume is attached.
personalization_source: Instead of relying on spreadsheets, ERPs, and manual processes, teams can create programmable workflows for tasks like reporting, reconciliations, approvals, and integrations with systems like SAP.
